item.title: The Lord of the Rings’ Next Movie Officially Wraps Production, but Now the Hard Part Begins
item.description: Warner Bros. announced on Nov. 25, 2026, that production on the next installment in The Lord of the Rings movie franchise has wrapped. The Hunt for Gollum , directed by Andy Serkis, is currently headed for post-production ahead of the movie's Dec. 17, 2027 release. The news follows Serkis' announcement in November that filming had ended .

item.title: 20 Years Later, One of TV’s Greatest Sci-Fi Franchises Still Hasn’t Topped Its Riskiest Spin-Off
item.description: Last year was a mixed bag for Whovians. Disney dumped Doctor Who , leaving the franchise in such dire straits that the BBC had no choice but to look for someone new to steer the long-running sci-fi show into a new era. That said, the franchise also got a major win with Russell T. Davies and director Dylan Holmes-Williams’s climate-focused spin-off, The War Between Land and Sea , which debuted in the U.K. that December but still hasn't officially been released in the U.S.

item.title: 10 Classic Books Worth Reading Over and Over
item.description: Most of us treat classic literature like a checklist to conquer in high school or college and then never touch those books again. You power through the plot, underline a few quotes for a term paper, and move on to whatever else is new. The catch is that great books rarely reveal their most fascinating tricks on the first pass. When you already know the ending, your brain stops racing for answers and begins to notice the machinery holding all those mysteries and themes together. Suddenly, an unreliable narrator's sleight of hand becomes obvious, or a throwaway line in chapter two hits like a freight train in light of later developments .

item.title: 6 Fantasy Books Better Than Harry Potter
item.description: There's no denying that Harry Potter continues to be a phenomenon. After seven bestsellers translated into multiple languages, years of extravagant midnight release parties, eight big-budget films, a stage play, and theme parks, there's still enormous hype for both the upcoming HBO television show and an all-star re-recording of the audiobooks. Clearly, there is something about the boy who lived and his world that draws people in and keeps them captivated. All of this begs one very important question, however: how good are the Harry Potter books, really?

item.title: Ridley Scott’s Sci-Fi Thriller Masterpiece Is Officially Being Removed From Netflix
item.description: Ridley Scott is one of those staple filmmakers. The 88-year-old English director has made countless noteworthy films, TV shows, and commercials over the course of his prolific career, dabbling in so many genres that it’s difficult to narrow down the parameters of his work. With the release of this year’s The Dog Stars , Scott has directed 31 feature films. They don’t all share the same characteristics, but broadly, his films are known for huge and immersive sets, battles on an epic scale, and big and heady concepts.

item.title: How to get adrenaline in GTA 6
item.description: Adrenaline acts as an emergency boost to all your stats in Grand Theft Auto 6 , as it temporarily negates health, stamina, and focus loss. It's meant to get you out of an emergency situation safely or help you burst into a tense situation and mop it up fast. Unlike Zombix and other restoratives, though, you can't buy adrenaline — not from anywhere we've found so far, at least — nor can you expect to find it in abundance throughout Leonida. There is, however, a small set of locations you can reliably get adrenaline from.

item.title: Capcom Is Officially Killing Its 'Jurassic World Meets Overwatch' Shooter
item.description: Four years after the game's launch , Capcom is officially shutting down Exoprimal , the company's 5v5 action game about a futuristic dinosaur crisis. Capcom announced Tuesday that service for Exoprimal will be discontinued in September 2027 — meaning that Exoprimal will no longer be playable — and that the game will no longer be sold starting in March 2027.

item.title: All Peewees Billboard locations in GTA 6
item.description: Peewees Billboards are one of the many scannable WAiNK collectibles in Grand Theft Auto 6 , but they're also part of the Mr. Enigma X Peewees scavenger hunt. Mr. Enigma, a play on Dr. Pepper, and the Peewees, a play on Popeyes, have teamed up to create a challenge where you must find four Peewees billboards, and you'll earn a valuable reward.

item.title: 'Avengers: Doomsday' Is Making Sure Patrick Stewart Gets a Proper Sendoff
item.description: Patrick Stewart's final on-screen performance will arrive in December's Avengers: Doomsday , and Marvel is making sure the late actor receives a fitting farewell.

item.title: The 25 Best PS5 Games in 2026
item.description: That aside, the PS5's library has grown to the extent that there's a lot to sort through, and new and old PS5 owners will be wondering what to play. So here’s our living list of the best video games we’ve played on the platform — influenced by the personal tastes of the Polygon team — to be updated as more games come out.
